verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal coding agent, so a project instructions file for coding standards is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a file (for example an AGENTS.md-style rules file); the closest items are custom modes, custom tools, and file-based MCP configs, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
